_comment:
'If you have a base legs equipped, **transform** it into this, then equip this.' / 'Your Teklo Blaster attacks get **go again**.' / '**Battleworn**'. Mechanologist Action Equipment - Evo Legs (Bright Lights).

CLAUSE 2 (Teklo Blaster go again) IMPLEMENTED: shape copied from shipped tokens/quicken.json ('When you activate a weapon attack ... the attack gains go again' = STATIC_TRIGGERED + ON_PLAY_ACTIVATE_ATTACK + GAIN keyword GO_AGAIN). Verified end to end: engine._dsl_play_activate_attack_listener (engine.py:1531-1558) dispatches on 'attacking' - combat already live, which the effect needs - to every zone in _dsl_permanent_zones(attacker), and that zone list INCLUDES the equipment slots (engine.py:1452-1459), so this card hears it from the legs slot. GAIN keyword 'GO_AGAIN' routes through the keyword branch (effect_types.py:4927-4941) to _grant_go_again (effect_types.py:423-458): with live combat it grants 'Go Again' onto state.combat.keywords (deduplicated per CR 8.3.5c) and the engine pays the action point at the Resolution Step (engine.py:718-723). ATTACK_IS_NAMED reads name/names/card_name and matches the attack's slug with the colour suffix stripped (condition_types.py:218-232); weapon activations put the weapon itself on the stack as the attack (play.py:118-119, card=wc), so teklo_blaster matches. ATTACK_CONTROLLED_BY_YOU (condition_types.py:389-396) makes the printed YOUR explicit.

printed_keywords lists GoAgain, but the conditional-keyword shape (WHILE_STATIC + SOURCE_IS_ATTACK + GAIN) does NOT apply here and was deliberately not authored: that machinery strips an always-on printed keyword that applies to the CARD ITSELF under a gate. This card's go again belongs to OTHER attacks; the source is legs equipment that can never be an attack, so SOURCE_IS_ATTACK would make the ability unreachable, and a GoAgain entry sitting on equipment that never attacks is inert. Same reasoning as .drafts/blade_dance.json and the Luminaris case loader.conditional_keywords() documents as 'the printed keyword belongs to some other card - just the DB flattening the sentence'.

CLAUSE 1 (transform over base legs) NOT AUTHORED - inexpressible today, deliberately left off rather than authored dead. The triage list said TRANSFORM, but reading the handler shows it does not fit: _do_transform (effect_types.py:1048-1068) ALWAYS creates a NEW token via create_token with no destination and puts the sources under that token, and create_token routes non-aura/item/ally tokens to controller.tokens (effect_keywords.py:398-399) - authoring to=evo_rapid_fire_blue would mint a duplicate unequipped copy in the tokens zone AND pull the base legs out of the legs slot, a wrong board state rather than a partial one. I follow the reading of sibling drafts evo_zoom_call_yellow / evo_data_mine_yellow / evo_charging_rods_yellow (clause left off) over evo_scatter_shot_blue / evo_buzz_hive_yellow / evo_heartdrive_blue (clause authored with the destination gap flagged). Separately, play.py offers no action to play equipment from hand, so a PLAY-time transform is unreachable today regardless; when a generic fix lands (one line in _do_transform passing destination='legs'), clause 1 is TRANSFORM sources [{"zone": "legs", "from": "Base Legs"}] on a PLAY ability.

Battleworn is a printed keyword firing from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored.

Release note ('does not have the base subtype; can NOT be transformed into another evo'): nothing here contradicts it while clause 1 is unauthored; when other evos' transform clauses become expressible they must reach this card only as a TARGET (sources from Base Legs), never as something this transforms into.
